html:
Seychelles International Airport opened on Mahé in 1971, built on land reclaimed from the sea, and for the first time linked the islands to the world by regular flights.

Before it, the Seychelles could be reached only by ship, a few times a month, and lived on copra, cinnamon and fishing. Within a few years hotels spread along the beaches, and tourism became the largest industry.

Tourism made the country the richest in Africa per head. It also made the islands a prize: the coup of 1977 and a failed mercenary plot in 1981, whose fighters were discovered at this airport, came in the years after it opened. Nature sites such as the Vallée de Mai became national assets.
sum: Seychelles International Airport opened on Mahé in 1971, built on land reclaimed from the sea, and for the first time linked the islands to the world by regular flights.
